{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Redefine conversion as status == 'completed'
sales_df['conversion'] = (sales_df['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel (email - paid_search)
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('channel')['conversion'].mean()
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']
difference_raw = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Output raw difference
print(f"Raw difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {difference_raw}")"}
